hypothesis: The unquantized BF16 Qwen3-8B can run fully on yukabox's integrated Radeon through ROCm, preserve the 11/12 quality of the prior BF16 CPU whole-chat test, and generate faster than the prior approximately 1.4 tokens per second.

input.source: The same two private cleaned Codex conversations and six questions used by Gate 16B.1

success.fit: All transformer layers are offloaded to ROCm without out-of-memory or host fallback.
success.quality: At least 11/12 manual points on the same six questions.
success.speed: Generated-token throughput is greater than 1.4 tokens per second.

boundary: This is one development run on one integrated GPU. Passing does not prove identical token sequences across CPU and ROCm; it tests preserved task quality under the locked manual rubric.
